verdict.rationale: Bruno's CLI can run collections headlessly and integrate into CI/CD pipelines, and Docker images let it run without manual intervention, which supports scheduling background automation of API tests (bruno-docs-3, bruno-docs-18, bruno-probe-4). However, this is scripted test/CI automation, not an AI-native autonomous agent capability — there's no evidence of AI-driven decision-making, triggers, or persistent background agents. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent orchestration, autonomous triggering/decision logic, or persistent background execution beyond CI/CD-scheduled runs.
